svg.title: Methods and tools
svg.desc: Programming: Python, R, Java, C/C++, JavaScript, Bash/Linux; Machine learning: Deep Learning, Reinforcement Learning, Ensemble Learning; Geospatial: GIS, Google Earth Engine, Remote Sensing; Earth system modeling: General Lake Model (GLM), Variable Infiltration Capacity (VIC), Community Land Model (CLM); Computing & development: Docker, Azure, Git
